query:
WITH created AS (
             INSERT INTO tags (name, display_name, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES ($1, $2, now(), now())
             ON CONFLICT ((lower(name))) DO NOTHING
             RETURNING id
           )
           SELECT id AS "id!" FROM created
           UNION ALL
           SELECT id FROM tags WHERE lower(name) = lower($1)
           LIMIT 1
